menuItems.name: Double Cheese Veg Supreme Burger
menuItems.description: Crispy herb potato patty topped with double cheddar cheese, sliced farm tomatoes, crisp lettuce, and smoky mayo.

menuItems.name: South Indian Masala Dosa
menuItems.description: Crisp golden crepe folded over spiced mashed potato masala, served with fresh coconut chutney and hot lentil sambar.

menuItems.name: Special Campus Deluxe Thali
menuItems.description: Wholesome royal meal: Paneer Butter Masala, Dal Makhani, Seasonal Sabzi, Steamed Jeera Rice, 2 Butter Rotis, Gulab Jamun, and Papad.

menuItems.name: Mumbai Special Butter Pav Bhaji
menuItems.description: Spiced mashed potato-tomato gravy topped with butter dollop, served with 2 soft toasted buttery pavs and chopped onions.

menuItems.name: Thick Cold Coffee with Choco Ice Cream
menuItems.description: Blended roasted espresso made with chilled full-cream milk, cocoa drizzle, and crowned with chocolate ice cream.

menuItems.name: Paneer Tikka Grilled Jumbo Sandwich
menuItems.description: Triple-layer artisan bread toasted with smoky marinated tandoori paneer, capsicum, mozzarella, and spiced mint mayo.

menuItems.name: Hyderabadi Paneer Dum Biryani
menuItems.description: Long-grain fragrant basmati rice slow-cooked with saffron, royal whole spices, marinated cottage cheese, and cucumber raita.

menuItems.name: Burger + Fries + Cold Coffee Combo
menuItems.description: Double Cheese Veg Burger + Small Peri Peri Fries + Thick Cold Coffee. The signature campus saver combo!

menuItems.name: Cutting Masala Chai (Kulhad Cup)
menuItems.description: Authentic Indian milk tea slow-brewed with crushed ginger, green cardamom, and cloves. Served steaming in clay kulhad.

menuItems.name: Samosa Chaat with Sweet Curd & Chutneys
menuItems.description: Crushed crispy golden samosas topped with spiced chole, sweet dahi, tamarind chutney, mint dip, and crunchy nylon sev.

menuItems.name: Amritsari Chole Bhature
menuItems.description: Two fluffy golden fried bhaturas paired with rich spiced Punjabi chickpea masala, lemon pickled onions, and green chili.

recipes.instructions: Toast bun with butter, fry patty at 180°C, layer sauce, lettuce, tomato slice, and double cheese.
Boil & mash potatoes and tomatoes with bhaji masala, simmer with butter, toast pav with coriander butter.

recipes.menuItemName: Thick Cold Coffee with Choco Ice Cream
recipes.instructions: Blend espresso shot with chilled milk, sugar syrup, ice cubes, and top with scoop of chocolate ice cream.
Prepare fresh paneer gravy, jeera basmati rice, dal makhani, and hot tandoori butter rotis.
